entries.source: #PURPLE#Make sure you are connected and joined the main Tales of Maj'Eyal chat channel.
entries.target: #PURPLE#确认你连接到了网络，并加入了马基埃亚尔的传说的主聊天频道。
打开的史莱姆噬神者门

entries.source: This door seems to have been sealed off. You think you can open it.
entries.target: 这扇门似乎被封住了，你觉得你可以打开它。

entries.source: This rock is loose, you think you can move it away.
entries.target: 这块岩石看起来有些松动，你觉得你可以移开它。

entries.source: Do you #{strong}#really#{normal}# want to touch that?
A green oozing defence cell of the Maggot.
entries.target: 这团绿泥是巨大蛆虫的防御细胞。

entries.source: A reddish attack cell that will crawl to you to distract you while the rest of the organism attacks.
entries.target: 一团红色的攻击细胞，它会爬到你的身边，在这个生物体的其余部分发动攻击时分散你的注意力。

entries.source: This strange cell can somehow connect to Eyal itself.
entries.target: 这个奇怪的细胞似乎可以通过某种方法连接到埃亚尔本身。
你看起来像是营养成分。

entries.source: A huge globula of protoplasma. You can feel a kind of protosentience emanating from it, and you can tell it is hungry.
entries.target: 一大团原生质球体。你能感觉到某种原始感知从它身上散发出来，并且能看出它很饥饿。
